[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Targeted defect fixes for the prompt_prose wire, update races, [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Telegram transport, bundle caps, and triage conflicts[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Host-produced artifact-link origins, including prompt_prose, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]round-trip through the real sase_core_rs binding, and a contract [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]test fails on any future origin drift. Jobs and launches that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]overlap a code swap defer and retry instead of failing, an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]update-overlap reproducer guards that behavior, and a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]prebuilt-artifact cache miss is a miss rather than a failure. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Telegram falls back to plain text only on entity-parse errors, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]retries per chunk without resending delivered chunks, reports [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]credential and network outages once per state transition, and runs [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]its outbound job only on the sending machine. Every provider root [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bundle fits its declared max_bytes through compile-time compaction,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with a doctor check and a just-check test that catch growth. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bead_task_triage recovers from request_id_conflict by advancing the[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]generation.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add the prompt_prose artifact-link origin and a host-origin [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]binding contract test[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]prose_wire[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prose_wire: add PromptProse to sase-core's ArtifactLinkOriginWire with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the automatic, commit-scoped semantics sase already relies on, and move [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the pin. Give sase one constant listing every host-produced origin, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]round-trip each through sase_core_rs.artifact_link_validate_row in a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contract test. Record what the "wire is stale" skew message means.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Build an update-overlap reproducer for jobs, launches, and [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]native code[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]swap_repro[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]swap_repro: a test-only harness simulates an install swap in temp dirs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]under a real code-swap writer lock. It drives vanishing scripts, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vanishing binding, mixed-version lazy imports, and in-place versus [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]atomic file replacement. Still-failing modes become strict xfails for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the guard phases. Record which modes reproduce and how the real [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]installers replace files.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Defer and retry scheduler jobs that overlap a code swap[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]swap_chop_guards[dim] · [dim][/dim]after swap_repro[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]swap_chop_guards: the code-swap writer records a durable last-swap [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stamp. The chop runner does not start scripts while a writer is live, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and it treats a missing script within a short post-swap grace as [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inhibited. A run that overlapped a swap and died of SIGBUS or a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]swap-skew import error is recorded as a skipped retry, not an error. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Flip the chop xfails.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Defer and retry launches and finalizers that overlap a code [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]swap[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]swap_launch_guards[dim] · [dim][/dim]after swap_chop_guards[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]swap_launch_guards: agent launches, bead work, and host finalizers that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hit a missing binding or swap-skew import error during or just after a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]swap wait for it to end and retry. Long-lived processes stop mixing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pre-swap and post-swap modules. Fix in-place native-code replacement [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]only if the reproducer triggered SIGBUS. Flip the remaining xfails.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Treat a prebuilt Rust artifact cache miss as a miss, not a [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]failure[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]prebuild_miss[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prebuild_miss: prebuild consume exits 0 and records hit:false with its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reason on a cache miss. Dev-update reconcile records the step as a miss,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]then builds from source. The prebuild producer's writer probe also [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recognizes install.dev and install.pypi swaps.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fall back to plain text only on entity-parse errors and retry [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]per chunk[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]tg_transport[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tg_transport: in sase-telegram, plain-text fallback fires only for an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]entity-parse BadRequest. Timeouts, network errors, rate limits, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]credential errors reach the retry wrapper unchanged. Retries wrap each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chunk, so delivered chunks are never resent, and the outbound job [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resumes a partly delivered notification at its first undelivered chunk.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Collapse repeated Telegram credential and network failures [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]into degraded states[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]tg_degraded[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tg_transport[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tg_degraded: outbound and receiver track a persisted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]credential_unavailable or network_degraded state. Each logs one line on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]entering a state, rate-limited summaries while degraded, and one line on[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery, with no tracebacks for transient errors. One SASE notice fires[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per transition. Credential lookups are negatively cached for a short [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]window.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Run the Telegram outbound routine only on the sending machine[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]tg_scope[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tg_scope: move the axe.routines.telegram routine from the shared chezmoi[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase.yml into sase_athena.yml next to the telegram_receiver proc. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Confirm the machine overlay loads it on athena and leaves apollo and mac[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]without it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Compact oversize provider root bundles at compile time until [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]they fit[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]bundle_trim[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bundle_trim: when a provider declares max_bytes and the delivered bundle[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]would exceed it, compile applies a deterministic compaction ladder. Step[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]one drops summaries from superseded list-roster entries. Step two [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]compacts whole list rosters, largest first. Bundles that already fit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stay byte-identical, and no memory file changes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Gate provider bundle sizes in sase doctor and just check[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bundle_gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bundle_trim[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bundle_gate: a sase doctor check renders every enabled project's root [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bundle for each provider that declares max_bytes. It errors over the cap[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and warns when compaction was needed. A just-check test keeps sase's own[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bundles under every cap without compaction. Update the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instruction-bundle and Codex provider docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  11 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Advance bead_task_triage's generation on request_id_conflict[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]triage_conflict[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]triage_conflict: when gate creation fails with request_id_conflict, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bead_task_triage cancels any pending gate under the stale id and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]advances and persists the generation. It then recreates the gate in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]same pass. Other failures keep the deterministic retry.[/#D7D7AF]
